title: Rank-zero projective bundle quotient
statement: For a normalized projective bundle realization of a rank-one module, the quotient is an isomorphism and the one-coordinate structural morphism is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Choose a Zariski frame cover of the rank-one module. The one-coordinate projective chart is all of the projective space, by the standard-open cover indexed by a unique type. Its normalized quotient section is therefore a global free generator and is an isomorphism on sections. The sole free-basis inclusion is the inverse of freeUniqueIso, so cancellation of the source trivialization proves that the universal quotient restricts to an isomorphism. Transport tensor pullback to the adjoint pullback and reflect isomorphisms along the jointly surjective open cover. The inverse quotient supplies the stated line-module isomorphism. On each base frame open the structural morphism is the composite of the frame isomorphisms and the one-coordinate projective-space structural isomorphism. Target locality of isomorphisms proves the global structural assertion. The argument also covers the empty base.

    {B : Scheme.{u}} {F : B.Modules} [F.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank (0 + 1)]

      IsIso D.A.data.relProjHom
